task_text: 比较给定视频 A 与候选视频 B，调查两者可由材料确认的差异及其对画面含义的影响。引用具体证据，说明差异所在位置和未能确定的内容。给定候选不代表已经确认其来源身份；不要把未检查的区域或模态视为没有差异。
task_text_en: Compare the given video A with the candidate video B, and investigate the differences between them that the materials can confirm and how those differences affect what the footage means. Cite specific evidence, and state where the differences are and what could not be determined. Being given as a candidate does not mean B's source identity has been confirmed; do not treat unexamined regions or modalities as having no difference.

required_evidence.description: 两段视频的抽帧（差异位置两侧的对应帧）
diff_media 产出的逐帧差异图（差异时间线、差异框与成对放大），可替代成对抽帧作为差异位置的证据
两段视频的媒体属性（时长、帧率、音轨数）
视觉或音频对齐结果（候选对应时间锚点，只作线索）

requirements.text: A 相对 B 是否存在丢帧/缩短（官方描述：0:00–0:15 段被压成约 10 秒，须由画面确认），以及两侧对应位置
requirements.text_en: Whether A has dropped frames / is shortened relative to B (official description: the 0:00-0:15 section is compressed to about 10 seconds; to be confirmed from the footage), and the corresponding positions on both sides

requirements.text: 音轨是否可取得；可确认的声音差异或无法核验的说明
requirements.text_en: Whether the audio tracks could be obtained; any confirmable audio difference, or a statement that it could not be verified

requirements.text: 已确认的差异对画面含义的影响（不把未检查的区域或模态当作没有差异）
requirements.text_en: How the confirmed differences affect what the footage means (unexamined regions or modalities are not treated as having no difference)

requirements.text: 未能确定的内容；不预设候选视频 B 的来源身份或制作先后
requirements.text_en: What could not be determined; the source identity or production order of candidate video B is not presupposed

notes: 官方编辑描述（reference_status: 需由画面确认）：Drop frames from 0:00 to 0:15 to make it into a 10 second video；Manipulation: Frame duplication/Reversed Frames/Frame dropping/Speeding up/Slowing down；label_expected 经 2026-09-28 审稿决定不写：子串匹配表达不了官方描述（见 cases_draft/review_20260928_labels_offline.md）
